coming.title: The next offer of main
coming.what: preview has 737 working functions and main 701, but Claude does not offer main yet (apart from the one-file mend for the web sites, above). Since 18 November the check stops a motion where two parts meet, as the viewer does. The early stops are being sorted by cause, one function at a time: missing connections and file faults are mended as they are found (eight sign-offs on 18 November), and a rule that lets a contact guide a motion is being measured. Before the offer: the two solver changes told apart (their full check lost 10 functions and gained none, so neither is merged as it is), a full check of preview, and a slow check of the 8110 on the commit offered.
